canonical_project: OADC Umhlanga (former NTT Data SA / Internet Solutions facility)
owner: Open Access Data Centres (OADC) / WIOCC Group (formerly NTT Data SA / Internet Solutions)
notes: Legacy Internet Solutions/NTT Data SA facility at 3 Sugar Close, Umhlanga (eThekwini) - listed on DataCenterMap and PeeringDB as NTT DATA Umhlanga/Durban; OADC's acquisition of seven NTT Data SA centres (Bloemfontein, Cape Town, East London, Gqeberha, Umhlanga, Bryanston, Parklands) concluded 31 Dec 2025, so current owner is OADC. Directory-grade evidence only; no public MW capacity; small regional colocation/edge facility.
